name: fetchcv-desktop
description: FetchCV local-first resume and job application agent
author: hesan

scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run electron:runtime && electron .
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run electron:runtime && npm run sidecar:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:unit: npm run backend:test && node --test tests/agent-events.test.mjs tests/pi-agent-runtime.test.mjs tests/pi-harness.test.mjs tests/provider-models.test.mjs tests/chat-scroll.test.mjs tests/processing-disclosure.test.mjs tests/model-protocol.test.mjs tests/composer-layout.test.mjs tests/interaction-inputs.test.mjs tests/sidebar-grouping.test.mjs tests/window-chrome.test.mjs tests/resume-editor-layout.test.mjs tests/agent-platform-ui.test.mjs tests/appearance-runtime.test.mjs tests/job-description-import.test.mjs tests/interview-intelligence.test.mjs tests/interview-source-links.test.mjs tests/xiaohongshu-adapter.test.mjs
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && npm run electron:runtime && node --test tests/chat-scroll.test.mjs && node tests/electron.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:provider: npm run build && npm run electron:runtime && node --test tests/provider-models.test.mjs && node tests/provider.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:real-materials: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m pytest backend/tests/test_agent_real_materials.py backend/tests/test_resume_continuity.py -q --basetemp backend/.pytest-real-tmp && node --test tests/job-description-import.test.mjs
scripts.backend:migrate: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:unit
